NIGHT & LIFESTYLE

STUDY 062
Cream Turtleneck at a Teahouse Table
Rights check / Repeats Study 66.
Source: 24412.jpg
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long, soft brown hair sits
at a wooden table in a traditional teahouse, holding a
glass water bottle. She wears a cream ribbed turtleneck
and a dainty gold pendant necklace. Bowls of noodles
and cups of tea sit in front of her. Her expression is
relaxed, with a gentle smile. Warm, late-afternoon light
through wooden lattice windows. Palette of cream,
honey wood, and soft blue. Warm and cozy, in the style
of a casual travel lifestyle photo.
Warm, cozy, candid
WORKING NOTES
- The warm light through the lattice windows sets the
mood.
- Keep the tea and noodles for a sense of place.
